paper.title: Spectrum: Speedy and Strictly-Deterministic Smart Contract Transactions for Blockchain Ledgers

risks: The inspected artifact reached probe level 3 but provided only build commands, not an extracted test, demo, or benchmark invocation.
The environment is flagged as requiring privileged operation, which may complicate secure sandboxing and reproducible evaluation.
No GPU or private data is required, but the exact workload packaging, dependencies, and end-to-end runtime are not established by the probe.
The repository has no visible stars and the recent paper currently has no recorded citations, so external adoption and impact are unproven.
A benchmark must enforce strict serial-order correctness; otherwise agents could obtain misleading throughput gains by weakening determinism.
Performance scoring may be hardware-sensitive and will require pinned CPU resources, fixed warm-up rules, and repeated trials.
